notes: Assumptions that change the number: four 200 g rump steaks with their fat cap (USDA top sirloin 1/8" trim); all of the sauce eaten; 1/2 cup chutney ≈ 160 g, 1/2 cup tomato sauce ≈ 140 g; both tbsp of oil counted. Sanity check: Lecker.de's monkey gland steak lists ~850 kcal per person for a 225 g rump with potatoes, corn and tomatoes; our 640 kcal is steak and sauce only, so it sits where that plate minus its sides would be. The sauce alone is ~210 kcal a serving, mostly sugar from the chutney and tomato sauce.
